meta.query_interpretation: Compare the distribution of trial phases for trials involving pembrolizumab versus trials involving nivolumab.

plan.interpretation: Compare the distribution of trial phases for trials involving pembrolizumab versus trials involving nivolumab.

assumptions: Each group is a separate ClinicalTrials.gov query.intr search, so group membership follows the registry's own search (including its synonym matching). A trial matching several groups is counted in each.
Studies with multiple values contribute once to each distinct category.
All 5,037 matching trials were analyzed, so counts are exact registry totals.
warnings: 720 matched trials had no drug field containing the group term (the registry matched them through synonyms or other fields); they are counted but cited only by their category value.
